add-256.title: Qashtouta (Phyllo Nut Bombs with Ashta)
add-256.culturalNotes: Qashtouta is a modern Egyptian sweet that spread in Ramadan, combining crisp filo with soft ashta and nuts in one bite.

add-256-i4.name: Mixed crushed nuts (pistachio, almond, walnut, hazelnut)

add-256-i6.name: Sugar and cinnamon for the nuts

instructions.1: Mix the nuts with the coconut, sugar and cinnamon.
instructions.2: Cut the filo into large squares and brush 3 layers with ghee, stacking them.
instructions.3: Put a spoon of ashta and a spoon of nuts in the centre, gather the edges up into a parcel (the 'bomb') and press.
instructions.4: Pack the parcels tightly in a greased tray and brush with ghee.
instructions.5: Bake at 180°C for 25-30 minutes until golden and crisp.
instructions.6: Pour over the cold syrup as soon as they come out and garnish with pistachios.

add-257.title: Harrak Osbao (Lentils with Pasta, Tamarind and Pomegranate)
add-257.culturalNotes: Harrak osbao is a Damascene Lenten dish whose name means 'he burned his finger', because people rush to eat it before it cools. The tang of pomegranate molasses and tamarind sets it apart.

add-257-i2.name: Dough (flour, water, salt) cut into small squares, or small pasta

instructions.1: Boil the lentils in plenty of water until cooked but still holding their shape.
instructions.2: Knead a stiff dough of flour, water and salt, roll thin and cut into small squares; fry half until crisp and keep for garnish.
instructions.3: Add the other half of the dough to the lentils and cook until done and thickened, then add the pomegranate molasses, tamarind, cumin and salt.
instructions.4: Fry half the onions, sliced, in olive oil until brown and crisp; chop the rest and sauté with the garlic and coriander, then add to the lentils.
instructions.5: Spoon into a dish, let it cool slightly, and garnish with the crispy onion, fried dough, toasted bread and coriander; serve warm or cold.

meat-08.title: Grilled Lamb Steaks
meat-08.culturalNotes: This grilled dish showcases the Egyptian love of charred, aromatic meats. Long marination is key to tenderness and flavor absorption.

instructions.1: Season the meat with minced onion, salt, pepper, lemon juice, vinegar, and oil. Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours, up to 12 hours.
instructions.2: Prepare the grill and place meat pieces with a little oil and seasoned onion to keep them together on the grate. Grill until cooked through.
instructions.3: Transfer meat to a baking dish, cover, and bake in a preheated oven for 1.5 hours until fully cooked.

meat-09.title: Grilled Whole Chicken
meat-09.culturalNotes: This grilled dish showcases the Egyptian love of charred, aromatic meats. Long marination is key to tenderness and flavor absorption.

instructions.1: Split each chicken lengthwise in half and pound well. Marinate in the juice of two grated onions, lemon juice, vinegar, salt and pepper for at least 2 hours.
instructions.2: Brush the pieces with oil or ghee, then grill over charcoal, turning regularly.
instructions.3: Arrange on the serving plate with lemon wedges and fried potatoes.

mp10-8.name: green peppers, tomatoes, and onion for skewering

instructions.1: Cut the chicken into cubes and marinate with the minced onion, salt, pepper, spices, 1 tablespoon of mustard, 2 tablespoons of vinegar, lemon juice, and oil.
instructions.2: Cover and leave in the refrigerator for 4 hours.
instructions.3: Slice the green peppers and cut the onion into quarters, then thread the chicken pieces alternately with the vegetables onto skewers.
instructions.4: Grill the chicken over charcoal, and just before finishing, thread the tomatoes onto skewers to cook quickly.

meat-11.title: Beef Fillet or Chicken Breast in Broth

mp11-8.name: Vinegar, lemon juice, and ghee
mp11-8.standardAmount: 1 tbsp vinegar - juice of 1 lemon - 2 tbsp ghee

instructions.1: Season the meat or chicken with black pepper.
instructions.2: Prepare a pan with 2 tbsp of oil and one whole small onion, then sear the meat or chicken.
instructions.3: Sauté the minced garlic with finely chopped parsley or chopped green pepper, a little water, and salt; leave it on very low heat, adding water whenever necessary until it is cooked and the liquid is fully absorbed.
instructions.4: Additional method: Add 1 tbsp vinegar, the juice of one lemon, 2 tbsp ghee or oil, salt, and pepper to the meat or chicken, and leave it on very low heat while stirring continuously.
instructions.5: Gradually add water whenever needed until cooked, then remove the cooked meat.
instructions.6: Fry the two cubed potatoes, then place them in the sauce until they absorb the flavor.

meat-12.title: Meat with Green Peppers
meat-12.culturalNotes: This is a traditional Egyptian dish prepared with fresh ingredients and aromatic spices.

instructions.1: Slice the meat along with the onion and green peppers.
instructions.2: Brown the meat in oil or ghee, then set it aside.
instructions.3: Add the onion and sauté, then add the green peppers, return the meat to the pot, and season with salt and pepper, adding a little water as needed, covered, until cooked through.

meat-13.title: Lamb with Cumin (Kammuniya)
meat-13.culturalNotes: This spiced meat dish is a cornerstone of Egyptian home cooking, with cumin providing its distinctive warm, earthy note.

instructions.1: Cut the meat into small pieces and brown it in oil or ghee.
instructions.2: Add the crushed garlic in proportion to the meat, then add the cumin, and stir until the garlic turns golden.
instructions.3: Add a cup and a half of water with the tablespoon of vinegar and the whole onion, and simmer over low heat until cooked through.

meat-14.title: Meat with Tear Sauce
meat-14.culturalNotes: This is a traditional Egyptian dish prepared with fresh ingredients and aromatic spices.

instructions.1: Cut the meat into medium pieces and brown it in oil or ghee, then add the crushed garlic and stir until golden, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Blend the tomatoes and add them to the meat until the sauce thickens and cooks down.
instructions.3: Add the vinegar and stir well, then add about 2 cups of water, and simmer over low heat until fully cooked.

meat-15.title: Pan-Seared Beef
meat-15.culturalNotes: This is a traditional Egyptian dish prepared with fresh ingredients and aromatic spices.

instructions.1: Marinate the meat in onion juice, lemon juice or vinegar, salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Place the marinated meat in a pot with oil or ghee over low heat, covered, until it absorbs its own liquid; add a little more oil or ghee and stir until browned, then add water until fully cooked.

instructions.1: Slice the beef lengthwise into strips and season with salt, pepper, and spices.
instructions.2: Heat the oil or ghee in a pot, add the beef slices until browned, then remove them from the pot.
instructions.3: In the same pot, add the sliced onion and sauté, then add the beef slices along with the tablespoon of tomato paste; cover and leave over low heat.
instructions.4: Add water whenever the beef needs it until it is nearly cooked through.
instructions.5: Add the half cup of milk to the beef over low heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

instructions.1: Season the chicken with black pepper.
instructions.2: Heat the oil or ghee in a pan and sear all the chicken at once over high heat; flip to brown the other side, then remove from the pan.
instructions.3: In the same pan, add the finely chopped onions and the minced garlic and sauté, then add some water and salt and bring to a boil.
instructions.4: Finely chop the green pepper and mix it with the half cup of cream and the tablespoon of mustard, stirring well (the cream can be replaced with 1 tbsp of dissolved clotted cream mixed with a little milk).
instructions.5: Add the seared chicken to this mixture, return it to the pan, cover, and simmer over low heat until cooked through.

instructions.1: Season the chicken in the flour mixed with cumin, coriander, and salt.
instructions.2: Fry in oil until golden brown, then remove from the pan.
instructions.3: In the same pan, sauté the finely chopped onion, then add the minced garlic, salt, pepper, and thyme while stirring.
instructions.4: Add the tomato juice or tomato paste and cook until thickened, then place the chicken on top of the sauce, cover the pan, and add a little water if needed until cooked through.
instructions.5: Just before finishing, sprinkle with a little chopped parsley.

instructions.1: Marinate the chicken with only the juice of half the onion along with salt and pepper, then leave covered in the refrigerator for at least two hours.
instructions.2: Coat the chicken in flour, ensuring both sides are well-covered, then fry in oil until golden brown and remove from the pan.
instructions.3: Mix the minced garlic and minced cardamom with salt, pepper, and cinnamon, then sauté them in the same oil.
instructions.4: Finely dice the remaining half of the onion and sauté it with the aromatics.
instructions.5: Add the milk and water and bring to a boil, then place the fried chicken into the liquid and simmer until cooked, ensuring a little white sauce remains.

meat-20.title: Curry Chicken
meat-20.culturalNotes: Curry represents global influences in modern Egyptian cuisine, adding warm complexity to traditional dishes.

instructions.1: Cut the chicken into small pieces and sauté in very hot oil, covered while browning, until golden, then lift out of the oil.
instructions.2: Mix the flour with the curry powder, then gradually add 2 cups of water until it reaches a medium consistency.
instructions.3: Return the chicken to this mixture and simmer covered over low heat until cooked through.

instructions.1: Slice the beef into small strips and season with salt, pepper, and vinegar or lemon juice.
instructions.2: Sauté the seasoned beef strips in oil over low heat, covering the pan, and leave until half-cooked.
instructions.3: Dice the onions into small squares along with the tomato, green pepper, minced garlic, and chopped or minced parsley.
instructions.4: Add this mixture to the meat and cook until fully tender.
instructions.5: Dissolve 2 tbsp of tahini in 1 tbsp of vinegar, then gradually dilute with water until the desired consistency is reached, seasoning with salt and pepper.
instructions.6: Pour the tahini sauce over the meat, give it one quick stir, and remove from the stove.

meat-22.title: Shawarma with Spice Blend
meat-22.culturalNotes: This grilled dish showcases the Egyptian love of charred, aromatic meats. Long marination is key to tenderness and flavor absorption.

instructions.1: Cut the meat into thin, finger-like strips, then place it in a pot with oil over low heat, covered, without any seasoning, until it fully absorbs its own liquid.
instructions.2: Add enough water to cover it, and once the meat has absorbed about three-quarters of the water, add the spice packet and stir well.
instructions.3: Cut the tomato and green pepper into small pieces and add them to the meat with just one stir.

meat-23.title: Breaded Meat or Chicken Cutlets (Babtik)
meat-23.culturalNotes: Breaded cutlets (babtik) blend Egyptian home cooking traditions with European-style preparation techniques.

instructions.1: Pound the boneless meat or chicken pieces well, then season with salt, pepper, coriander, crushed garlic and thyme, along with onion juice and lemon juice (or any of the frying marinades).
instructions.2: Refrigerate for at least an hour.
instructions.3: Lift out of the marinade and coat in flour, then dip in egg beaten with salt and pepper, then coat in breadcrumbs, and fry in oil.
instructions.4: Vinegar, crushed cardamom, and a small amount of milk can be added to the marinade above.

meat-24.title: Soy-Marinated Chicken Breasts
meat-24.culturalNotes: This is a traditional Egyptian dish prepared with fresh ingredients and aromatic spices.

instructions.1: Cut the chicken into thin slices and marinate with onion, salt, pepper and mixed spice, then add soy sauce in proportion to the chicken, along with lemon juice or vinegar.
instructions.2: Refrigerate for 3 hours.
instructions.3: Coat the marinated chicken in flour or cornstarch, then fry it in oil.

meat-25.title: Chicken Rissoles
meat-25.culturalNotes: This is a traditional Egyptian dish prepared with fresh ingredients and aromatic spices.

instructions.1: Mince the chicken and add breadcrumbs, then season with salt, pepper and lemon juice (or any of the frying marinades).
instructions.2: Knead in the egg and mix well until it forms a firm dough.
instructions.3: Shape into balls or fingers, as preferred.
instructions.4: Dip in egg, then breadcrumbs, and fry in oil.

mp26-7.name: eggs
mp26-7.standardAmount: 1 egg for the mixture + 1 for coating

instructions.1: Sauté the small minced onion in oil or ghee, then add the flour and cook until just golden, then remove from heat.
instructions.2: Off the heat, add the cup of milk along with the salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Return to medium heat and stir until the mixture thickens.
instructions.4: Season the cooked minced chicken with salt, pepper, and nutmeg, then mix it with the white sauce (bechamel).
instructions.5: Remove the pan from the heat, add one egg, and stir well.
instructions.6: Let the mixture cool completely, divide it into 6 pieces, and shape them into cutlet shapes.
instructions.7: Dip the pieces in a little flour, then coat with egg and breadcrumbs, and fry in oil.

mp27-3.name: salt, pepper, coriander, thyme, and cardamom

instructions.1: Cut the chicken into small pieces and season it in a mixture of flour, eggs, and milk; mix well, then add the blended green pepper and the spices.
instructions.2: Place in the refrigerator for 2 hours.
instructions.3: Coat in breadcrumbs and fry all pieces in plenty of oil once, then remove from heat, and fry a second time until golden yellow.
instructions.4: Serve with garlic sauce (Toum) (see salads section).
instructions.5: After boiling the chicken and cutting it into quarters, pound them lightly, then coat in flour mixed with a little baking powder, spices, mustard, and a little milk or water, and fry in oil.

meat-28.title: Egyptian Kentucky-Style Fried Chicken
meat-28.culturalNotes: This is a traditional Egyptian dish prepared with fresh ingredients and aromatic spices.

instructions.1: Marinate the chicken pieces in grated onion mashed with salt, pepper and mixed spice.
instructions.2: Coat the chicken pieces in flour mixed with cornstarch, then refrigerate for 3 hours.
instructions.3: Dip in egg, then breadcrumbs, refrigerate again until firm, then fry in oil.

instructions.1: After boiling the chicken, cut it into quarters and squeeze over it an onion rubbed with salt, pepper, spices, and the lemon juice.
instructions.2: Place in the refrigerator for at least one hour until well marinated.
instructions.3: Whisk 2 eggs with the milk, salt, pepper, and spices, then gradually add the flour using a whisk.
instructions.4: Place the chicken in the mixture and let it sit until it absorbs some of the liquid.
instructions.5: Fry in oil on both sides.
instructions.6: Season raw chicken with lemon juice and refrigerate for a full day, then make a mixture of 2 tbsp flour, a little milk, and garlic powder; dip the chicken pieces in it and fry thoroughly in oil.

instructions.1: Sauté the onion in oil, then add the pepper and garlic until they turn golden.
instructions.2: Mix the ground beef with the eggs and flour, kneading well, and season with spices.
instructions.3: Add the sautéed onion mixture to the ground beef and knead thoroughly.
instructions.4: Shape the mixture into balls, flatten them into circles, and dredge in flour.
instructions.5: Fry in very hot oil for only a few seconds, then flip to the other side just until they firm up.
instructions.6: After light frying, cover the patties with layers of foil and stack them in the freezer until frozen; when ready to use, lightly grease a tray with oil, arrange the patties, and place in the oven until heated through.
instructions.7: Alternatively, grease a tray with oil, line the bottom with sliced peppers, arrange the patties on top, and bake in the oven until cooked through.

meat-31.title: Chicken Hamburger
meat-31.culturalNotes: Egyptian hamburgers are boldly seasoned with onions and spices, pan-fried to create juicy patties with caramelized edges.

instructions.1: Shred the boiled chicken and mix with the onion, crushed garlic, egg and oil, season with the spices (or any frying marinade), and shape into patties.
instructions.2: After mixing well, cover and refrigerate for 2 hours.
instructions.3: Lightly oil a non-stick pan and cook the patties over medium heat, turning, until done.

meat-32.title: Spiced Chicken Kofta
meat-32.culturalNotes: This spiced meat dish is a cornerstone of Egyptian home cooking, with cumin providing its distinctive warm, earthy note.

instructions.1: Knead the minced leftover chicken with the grated onion, salt, pepper and lemon juice, and refrigerate for an hour.
instructions.2: Shape into fingers or patties.
instructions.3: Coat in flour, then dip in beaten egg, then coat in breadcrumbs.
instructions.4: Deep-fry in oil or ghee.

mp33-6.name: minced garlic and parsley
mp33-6.standardAmount: 2 cloves garlic and a little parsley

instructions.1: Soak the Baladi bread in a little water until soft, then squeeze it thoroughly to remove all excess water.
instructions.2: Mix the bread well with the ground beef, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Grate the onion and squeeze it thoroughly to remove the liquid, using only the grated pulp; mix it well into the meat, then add the eggs (depending on the consistency of the mixture) along with the minced garlic and parsley, and knead well.
instructions.4: Form into small balls, then flatten them into discs.
instructions.5: Lightly coat the discs in breadcrumbs first, then use a brush to coat both sides with egg.
instructions.6: Fry in oil until golden brown.

mp34-6.name: salt, pepper, spices, and dried mint
mp34-6.standardAmount: 1 tsp mint, remaining spices to taste

instructions.1: After boiling the rice, drain it well, let it cool, and then process it in a food processor.
instructions.2: Season the ground beef with the onion, garlic, salt, pepper, and spices.
instructions.3: Mix the seasoned meat with the boiled rice and knead well with the egg.
instructions.4: Shape the mixture into fingers or rounds.
instructions.5: Steam until the shapes firm up, then let them cool.
instructions.6: Coat with egg and breadcrumbs, then fry in oil.
instructions.7: You can skip the steaming step by dredging the kofta fingers or rounds in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, and letting them rest in the refrigerator for one hour until firm before frying in oil.

mp35-7.name: vegetable sauce
mp35-7.standardAmount: the amount produced by the following recipe

instructions.1: Pulse the ground beef, onion, parsley, and dill in a food processor, then add the crushed rice and spices; blend until the mixture becomes thick.
instructions.2: Shape the mixture into small balls and fry them in oil.
instructions.3: Place the kofta in the sauce and let it simmer on low heat for 15 minutes.

meat-36.title: Making Vegetable Sauce
meat-36.servings: enough for a Kofta Rice casserole

instructions.1: Heat the oil and sauté the garlic only until golden, then add the tomato puree; season with salt, pepper, and vinegar, then remove from heat.
instructions.2: Prepare a pot with about 3 cups of boiling water, salt, and pepper, then add the finely diced carrots and cook for 15 minutes.
instructions.3: Add the diced potatoes to the carrots in the boiling water, then pour in the tomato sauce; cook over medium heat for 15 minutes until the sauce thickens.

mp37-2.name: medium onion, minced or onion juice

mp37-8.name: dam'a (soft tomato sauce)
mp37-8.standardAmount: the amount produced by the following recipe

instructions.1: Mix the ground meat with the onion (or onion juice), garlic, parsley, and spices.
instructions.2: Refrigerate for 1 hour.
instructions.3: Wash the rice and drain it thoroughly until completely dry, then process it in a food processor until fine.
instructions.4: Mix the ground rice thoroughly with the ground meat.
instructions.5: Shape into fingers or rounds as desired.
instructions.7: Remove and let cool, then fry in oil.
instructions.8: Place the fried kofta fingers into the dam'a, cover the pot, and cook over low heat until the kofta is cooked through and has absorbed some of the sauce.

instructions.1: Lightly sauté the garlic in ghee or oil, then add the tomato puree and cook until thickened.
instructions.2: Add the tablespoon of vinegar and stir well, then add the water and season with salt and pepper; bring to a boil.

mp39-6.name: prepared tomato sauce (starch recipe)
mp39-6.standardAmount: the amount produced from the sauce recipe

instructions.1: Season the ground meat with dill, garlic, breadcrumbs, and spices, then knead well.
instructions.2: Shape into fingers or rounds as desired.
instructions.3: Brown in oil or ghee.
instructions.4: Prepare a sauce similar to pasta sauce (starch section).
instructions.5: Once the sauce comes to a boil, add the kofta and simmer on low heat until cooked through.

mp40-6.name: Asag (minced meat filling with pine nuts)
mp40-6.standardAmount: the amount produced from the Asag recipe

instructions.1: Finely mince the meat with a little salt, then mince the onions and add them to the minced meat and process twice more.
instructions.2: Wash the bulgur several times and drain it thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add the bulgur to the minced meat, mix well, and season with spices, then process this mixture twice more.
instructions.4: Shape the mixture into egg-sized pieces, press a hole in the center with your finger, fill with a portion of the Asag, and seal it so that it remains hollow.
instructions.6: Additional method: After preparing and filling the kibbeh as described above, grease a tray and place half of the kibbeh mixture in it, then add a layer of Asag and pine nuts, then top with the remaining kibbeh mixture. Drizzle the surface with ghee or butter and cut into samosa-like shapes, then bake in a medium oven until cooked through and lightly browned on top.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee or oil and sauté the onion, then add the ground beef and spices, and cook over low heat until done, adding water as needed.

meat-42.title: Yogurt Marinade
meat-42.servings: enough for 1 kg meat or chicken

instructions.1: Blend the tomato, carrot, garlic, and celery in a blender, then add the yogurt, salt, and pepper.
instructions.2: Fry a sliced onion in oil, then add it to the mixture.
instructions.3: Marinate meat or chicken in this mixture.

meat-43.title: Tomato Sauce Marinade
meat-43.servings: enough for 1 kg of meat or chicken

mp43-5.name: salt, pepper, mixed spices, thyme, cinnamon, cloves, and cardamom

mp43-8.name: tomatoes or tomato paste and water

instructions.1: Pulse the onions, garlic, bell pepper, and all spices in a food processor.
instructions.2: Add the blended tomatoes or tomato paste and the oil, then mix well with the lemon juice.
instructions.3: Marinate the meat or chicken in this mixture.
instructions.4: Grease a baking tray with oil, place the marinated meat inside with a little water, cover, and bake in the oven.

meat-44.title: Meat or Chicken in Baking Dish (Rostopatllo)

mp44-8.name: Salt, pepper, mixed spices, thyme, cinnamon, cloves, and cardamom

instructions.1: Brown the meat or chicken in a pan with oil or ghee until golden, then transfer to a baking tray.
instructions.2: Season one large sliced onion with salt, pepper, mixed spices, cinnamon, thyme, and cloves, then add it to the meat in the tray, or use any oven-roasting seasoning.
instructions.3: Slice the green pepper and combine it with the minced garlic and tomato juice (or 2 tbsp of tomato paste diluted with water), then add to the meat or chicken.
instructions.4: Add an appropriate amount of water mixed with lemon juice or vinegar and crushed cardamom, bring to a boil, then drizzle oil on top.
instructions.5: Cover the tray with foil and place in the oven until cooked; near the end of cooking, remove the cover and leave the tray until all the liquid is fully absorbed.

meat-45.title: Meat or Chicken Baked with Vegetables

instructions.1: Steam the carrots, zucchini, and potatoes that have been cut into very small cubes.
instructions.2: Make a mixture of onion rings, green pepper, cheddar cheese slices, olives, salt, and pepper.
instructions.3: Add this mixture to the steamed vegetables and knead well.
instructions.4: Grease a baking tray with oil, spread a layer of the vegetable mixture, then add a layer of the meat or chicken.
instructions.5: Brush the top with beaten egg and sprinkle with breadcrumbs.
instructions.6: Cover and place in the oven.
